items.passage: Questions 1-2 refer to the following e-mail. From: To: Subject: Greg <coachgreg@home.com> All students<group@home.com> The School Volleyball Dear students, The School Volleyball season will start soon. Please take a notice of the schedule. - Boy's training will begin from next Friday (23rd). - Girl's training will begin the next day. Please get ready for the training. - Both boys and girls must get a physical checkup from a hospital. - You are required to submit a doctor's note before you join the training. - All participants must pay $50 for uniforms, meals and others. I wish all of you and your family good luck. With best wishes, Your Coach

choices.B: Only boys need to have a health checkup.
choices.C: A doctor's note should be submitted before the training.
choices.D: Greg is a volleyball coach. Questions 3-4 refer to the following letter. Dear Ann, You are cordially invited to the 50th Wedding Anniversary party of Luke and Josephine Martin. It will be held on Saturday, November 5th, 2007 at the Eastview Community Hall 228 Montreal Road, Vanier, Ontario. Dinner will start at 5:30 p.m. The band, "Swing," will perform from 7:00 to 9:00 p.m. A donation to the Eastview Hospital will be accepted instead of a gift. Sincerely, The Martins
